prepare.description: When the context is nearly full, the older part is summarized in the background, so the switch happens without a wait when compaction is due. Off means compacting only once the limit is reached, as before. Allowed: true or false. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
prepare.title: Prepare compaction early

additionalProperties.description: Presets that turn on what they don't list follow this switch for the skill, script or MCP server, except where a preset turns it on or off itself. Presets that leave unlisted features off ignore it. Allowed: true or false. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
additionalProperties.title: Turn this skill, script or MCP server on

additionalProperties.description: When on, the server's tools send only their names and descriptions and load before use; when off, they are sent in full. A tool with its own setting follows that one. Allowed: true or false. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
additionalProperties.title: Load this MCP server's tools on demand

additionalProperties.description: When on, only the tool's name and description are sent, and its full parameters load before use; when off, it is sent in full. Unset follows how it was registered (scripts and MCP servers load on demand, built-in and extension tools go in full). Allowed: true or false. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
additionalProperties.title: Load this tool on demand

extract_idle.description: Once the conversation has been quiet this long, the AI turns what is worth keeping from the new part into memories. Allowed: a length of time from 1m to 1h, written like 30s, 10m or 1h. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
extract_idle.title: Wait before organizing memories

extract_turns.description: The AI organizes only after at least this many turns since the last time. Allowed: a whole number from 1 to 100. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
extract_turns.title: Turns before organizing

merge_every.description: After this long the AI goes over new and older memories together: drops repeats and outdated ones, and writes a summary of what it knows about you. Allowed: a length of time from 1h to 720h, written like 30s, 10m or 1h. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
merge_every.title: How often to consolidate memories

merge_sessions.description: Consolidate only after memories have been taken from at least this many chats since the last time. Allowed: a whole number from 1 to 100. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
merge_sessions.title: Chats before consolidating

organizer.description: The model used to organize memories, billed by usage. If none is chosen, the chat model is used. Allowed: <provider>/<model> or @<pool>. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
organizer.title: Memory organizer model

every.description: Fetch again once the cached catalog is this old. Allowed: a length of time from 1h to 720h, written like 30s, 10m or 1h. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect immediately.
every.title: Update every

update.description: Fetch a newer model catalog from models.dev in the background. Off uses only the bundled and already fetched ones. Allowed: true or false. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect immediately.
update.title: Update the catalog

url.description: Where to fetch the model catalog from. Allowed: an address starting with http:// or https:// or { env = "…" }. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect immediately.
url.title: Catalog address

chat.description: The model new sessions use, written as provider/model, for example deepseek/deepseek-flash, or @pool. Allowed: <provider>/<model> or @<pool>. Only in the system config or personal settings. Applies to new sessions.
chat.title: Chat model

base.description: How long a whole provider rests the first time it fails to authenticate or runs out of quota. It doubles each time in a row. Allowed: a length of time from 1s to 1h, written like 30s, 10m or 1h. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect immediately.
base.title: Auth failure pause

max.description: The pause for a whole provider stops doubling here. Allowed: a length of time from 1s to 24h, written like 30s, 10m or 1h. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect immediately.
max.title: Auth failure pause cap

base.description: How long an endpoint rests the first time it is rate limited. It doubles each time in a row. Allowed: a length of time from 1s to 1h, written like 30s, 10m or 1h. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect immediately.
base.title: Rate limit cooldown

max.description: The rate limit cooldown stops doubling here, even when the provider asks for longer. Allowed: a length of time from 1s to 24h, written like 30s, 10m or 1h. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect immediately.
max.title: Rate limit cooldown cap

base.description: How long an endpoint rests the first time it cannot be reached or fails on its side. It doubles each time in a row. Allowed: a length of time from 1s to 1h, written like 30s, 10m or 1h. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect immediately.
base.title: Error cooldown

max.description: The cooldown for these errors stops doubling here. Allowed: a length of time from 1s to 24h, written like 30s, 10m or 1h. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect immediately.
max.title: Error cooldown cap

embedding.description: Improves search quality for memories, knowledge bases and more. Allowed: local, off or <provider>/<model>. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
embedding.title: Semantic model

vision.description: Looks at images for the chat model when it cannot. Written like the chat model. Allowed: <provider>/<model> or @<pool>. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
vision.title: Vision model

key.description: Needed when Brave is the search provider. Allowed: { secret = "…" } or { env = "…" }. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
key.title: Brave Search

key.description: Needed when DeepSeek is the search provider; if unset, the key of your DeepSeek model provider is used. Charged per search. Allowed: { secret = "…" } or { env = "…" }. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
key.title: DeepSeek

key.description: With a key, searches use your own Exa quota; without one, the free quota. Allowed: { secret = "…" } or { env = "…" }. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
key.title: Exa

url.description: Your own SearXNG instance, for example http://127.0.0.1:8888, with the JSON format enabled. Used when SearXNG is the search provider. Allowed: an address starting with http:// or https:// or { env = "…" }. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
url.title: SearXNG address

source.description: Which service AI uses to search the web. Auto tries Exa, Parallel, Firecrawl, AnySearch and You.com in turn and rests any that hit a rate limit; a chosen one is tried first, then the others. These services are outside China and receive the search terms. Pages that can't be fetched directly are fetched by Exa, Firecrawl or Parallel, which then receive the address. Allowed: auto, exa, parallel, firecrawl, anysearch, you, deepseek, tavily, brave, searxng, duckduckgo or bing. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
source.title: Search provider

key.description: Needed when Tavily is the search provider. Allowed: { secret = "…" } or { env = "…" }. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
key.title: Tavily

level.description: Which level new sessions start at: the workspace lets the AI read and write in the workspace and runs commands in the sandbox; full access asks nothing and skips the sandbox. Applies to sessions opened on this machine. Allowed: workspace or full. Only in the system config or personal settings. Applies to new sessions.
level.title: Permission level for new sessions

start_read_only.description: When on, new sessions begin read-only. The AI can look around and plan, and you turn read-only off when files should change. A project config can only turn it on. Allowed: true or false. Only in the system config, personal settings or a project config. Applies to new sessions.
start_read_only.title: Start new sessions read-only

default.description: The persona new sessions use. When unset, new sessions have no persona: no character prompt, and a memory of their own. Allowed: a name starting with a lowercase letter, using only lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 64 characters. Only in the system config or personal settings. Applies to new sessions.
default.title: Default persona

description.description: One line the AI sees after the pool name when it starts a subagent. Write it in English. Allowed: one line of English, at most 60 characters. Only in the system config or personal settings. Applies to new sessions.
description.title: Description for the model

models.description: A group of models, each written as provider/model. Allowed: a list of <provider>/<model>. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
models.title: Pool members

strategy.description: Keep a session on one member, or take the next member for every request. Left out, a pool whose members are all billed per request rotates and the others pin. Allowed: pin or rotate. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
strategy.title: Pool strategy

subagent.description: When on, the AI can pick this pool for a subagent in new sessions. It is listed only once it has members. Allowed: true or false. Only in the system config or personal settings. Applies to new sessions.
subagent.title: Subagents can pick it

default.description: The preset new sessions use. Allowed: a name starting with a lowercase letter, using only lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 64 characters. Only in the system config or personal settings. Applies to new sessions.
default.title: Default preset

about.description: Anything you want the AI to know about you; can be left empty. Not included in group chats on messaging platforms. Allowed: text of at most 2000 characters; line breaks allowed. Only in personal settings. Applies to new sessions.
about.title: More about you

name.description: How the AI addresses you, such as your name or a nickname. Allowed: text of at most 64 characters. Only in personal settings. Applies to new sessions.
name.title: What the AI calls you

preferred_reply_language.description: The language the AI replies in by default. You can ask it to switch at any time. Allowed: text of at most 64 characters. Only in personal settings. Applies to new sessions.
preferred_reply_language.title: What language should the AI reply in

base_url.description: The address of this provider's API; the driver adds the path. Known providers can leave it out. Allowed: an address starting with http:// or https:// or { env = "…" }. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
base_url.title: Address

cache.description: How this provider bills its cache. For now it only decides how a pool without a strategy splits. Left out, it follows the driver. Allowed: contract, best_effort or per_request. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
cache.title: Cache class

catalog.description: Which provider in the model data this one is, for example deepseek for a relay that only forwards DeepSeek. Allowed: a name starting with a lowercase letter, using only lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 64 characters. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
catalog.title: Catalog provider

strict_tools.description: This provider writes only what the parameter schema allows, so a tool shown with an empty schema gets {}. When on, tools that need loading are sent to it in full. Left out, it follows the profile. Allowed: true or false. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
strict_tools.title: Constrained decoding

driver.description: How to talk to this provider. Known providers can leave it out. Allowed: openai-chat, anthropic or openai-responses. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
driver.title: Driver

key.description: Write { secret = "name" } (saved with miyu login) or { env = "VARIABLE" }. One per provider; to use several quotas together, set up several providers and put them in a pool. Without one, no auth header is sent. Allowed: { secret = "…" } or { env = "…" }. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
key.title: Key

local.description: A model service on this machine, counted as free. Left out, it follows the address: on this machine means yes. Allowed: true or false. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
local.title: Local service

catalog.description: Which models.dev entry to use: <provider>/<model>. Left out, it is found by name. Allowed: text of at most 256 characters. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
catalog.title: Catalog entry

effort.description: The reasoning effort this model uses by default: one of its levels, for example high, or off where thinking can be turned off. Left out, the provider decides. Allowed: text of at most 32 characters. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
effort.title: Default reasoning effort

inputs.description: What this model can read: text, images, PDF, audio, video. Allowed: a list of text, image, pdf, audio or video. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
inputs.title: Inputs

max_output.description: How many tokens this model can write at most in one reply. Allowed: a whole number from 1 to 100000000. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
max_output.title: Max output

cache_read.description: Price per million tokens read from the cache. Allowed: a number from 0 to 1000000. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
cache_read.title: Cache read price

cache_write.description: Price per million tokens written to the cache. Allowed: a number from 0 to 1000000. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
cache_write.title: Cache write price

currency.description: Currency of the price, three capital letters such as USD or CNY. USD if left out. Allowed: text of at most 3 characters. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
currency.title: Currency

input.description: Price per million input tokens. A written price is used whole. Allowed: a number from 0 to 1000000. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
input.title: Input price

output.description: Price per million output tokens. Allowed: a number from 0 to 1000000. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
output.title: Output price

price_multiplier.description: Prices of this model are multiplied by it, over the one on the provider. Allowed: a number from 0 to 1000. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
price_multiplier.title: Price multiplier

reasoning.description: Which reasoning levels this model offers. Allowed: a list of text of at most 32 characters. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
reasoning.title: Reasoning levels

temperature.description: The temperature this model uses by default, from 0 to 2; higher gives looser answers. Left out, the provider decides. Not sent to models that do not take one. Allowed: a number from 0 to 2. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
temperature.title: Default temperature

tools.description: Whether this model can call tools. Allowed: true or false. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
tools.title: Tool calls

window.description: The context window of this model, in tokens. Allowed: a whole number from 1 to 100000000. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
window.title: Context window

name.description: The name people see. The id is only for referring to models; without one, the model data's name for this provider is used, then the id. Allowed: text of at most 64 characters. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect immediately.
name.title: Display name

price_multiplier.description: Prices of this provider are multiplied by it. 1 if left out. A multiplier on the model wins. Allowed: a number from 0 to 1000. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect next turn.
price_multiplier.title: Price multiplier

idle_new_after.description: After this many minutes without a message, the next one starts a new terminal session; the old one is kept. 0 never starts a new one. Allowed: a whole number from 0 to 525600. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect immediately.
idle_new_after.title: New session after idle

persona.description: The persona for a new terminal session. Unset follows the default persona. A terminal session in use keeps its own. Allowed: a name starting with a lowercase letter, using only lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 64 characters. Only in the system config or personal settings. Applies to new sessions.
persona.title: Terminal session persona

preset.description: The preset for a new terminal session. Unset follows the default preset. Allowed: a name starting with a lowercase letter, using only lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 64 characters. Only in the system config or personal settings. Applies to new sessions.
preset.title: Terminal session preset

head.description: The interface plain miyu opens. Allowed: a name starting with a lowercase letter, using only lowercase letters, digits, - and _, up to 64 characters. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect after restart.
head.title: Default interface

language.description: The language terminals, the web page and the command line use for you. auto follows the terminal or browser. Allowed: auto, zh, en or ja. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect immediately.
language.title: Interface language

startup.description: Whether a terminal interface or the web page opens a new session or picks up the most recent one. Allowed: new or recent. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect after restart.
startup.title: On start, open

welcomed.description: This account has finished the first-run guide; the terminal and web pages no longer open it. Allowed: true or false. Only in personal settings. Takes effect immediately.
welcomed.title: First-run guide done

currency.description: Amounts are added up per currency, never converted. This one is listed first, the others by code. Three capital letters such as USD or CNY. Allowed: text of at most 3 characters. Only in the system config or personal settings. Takes effect immediately.
currency.title: Currency shown first
